observations: The corrected implementation with sorted roles reproduces both parent orderings exactly (PC1 PASS): DEF-FULL-MAP cart>product_listing>detail and DEF-FORM-ONLY product_listing>cart>detail

The canonical per-iteration p=0.5 null recipe produces mean pairwise agreement 0.5273 at seed=42, within 0.0002 of the parent's stored value 0.5275 (NC1 PASS). The prior 0.0119 deviation was entirely caused by unsorted set iteration (PYTHONHASHSEED) + estimator mismatch, both now fixed
Under the canonical recipe, observed 0.3 < null 0.5273, so C2 = FALSE (ordering is LESS stable than random). This reproduces the parent's FALSIFIED intent across all 10 seeds (M9: all FALSE)
ISOLATED-A-LINK ordering matches DEF-FULL-MAP exactly, confirming that a->link mapping (without menuitem/tab) is the primary driver of the DEF-FULL-MAP reversal relative to DEF-FORM-ONLY
Seed robustness: SD across 10 seeds = 0.0103 (F3 not triggered). Mean ranges from 0.5237 to 0.5543 across seeds, all well above observed 0.3. C2 direction is FALSE for every seed

The parent's 0.3 value was computed from 5 definitions (C(5,2)=10 pairs); this run uses 3 definitions (C(3,2)=3 pairs). The observed agreement 0.333 (1/3) is consistent with the parent's 0.3 (3/10) given the reduced definition set
validity_notes: Truncated-first-20 locatable sample only (7 tasks, 1 Magento site, cart n=1). Results do not generalize to full-DOM or cross-site data
